description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the CommandResponse class in the org.eclipse.hono.client package. It verifies behavior related to creating CommandResponse instances from various inputs, handling malformed data, parsing responses from messages, and ensuring proper extraction of IDs and metadata.

classes.name: CommandResponseTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing various behaviors of CommandResponse, including creation, parsing, and validation of response messages.

methods.name: testFromResponseSucceeds
methods.description: Tests creating a CommandResponse from a valid request ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testFromFailsForRequestIdWithMalformedLengthPart
methods.description: Ensures that malformed request IDs with incorrect length parts fail to generate a valid response.

methods.name: testFromFailsForRequestIdWithMalformedReplyIdOptionBitsPart
methods.description: Checks that request IDs with invalid reply-to options bits fail.

methods.name: testFromFailsForInvalidStatusCode
methods.description: Verifies that responses with invalid HTTP status codes are rejected.

methods.name: testFromFailsForIncorrectCorrelationIdLength
methods.description: Ensures that request IDs with specified length mismatches fail when creating a response.

methods.name: testDeviceInReply
methods.description: Validates that device ID is included in reply-to ID when specified.

methods.name: testDeviceNotInReply
methods.description: Ensures device ID is not included in reply-to ID when not specified.

methods.name: testForDeviceIdInReplyToId
methods.description: Checks that the device ID is part of the reply-to ID extracted from a message.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForMissingCorrelationId
methods.description: Verifies failure when a message lacks a correlation ID.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForMissingAddress
methods.description: Verifies failure when a message lacks an address.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForMissingStatus
methods.description: Verifies failure when a message lacks the status property.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForInvalidStatus
methods.description: Ensures invalid status property values cause parsing to fail.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForInvalidAddressWithNothingBehindDeviceId
methods.description: Verifies failure when the address contains only the device ID with no further path.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForInvalidAddressWithOnlyReplyToOptionsBit
methods.description: Checks that addresses ending with only replyToOptions bit fail.

methods.name: testFromMessageFailsForInvalidAddressWithWrongReplyToOptionsBit
methods.description: Verifies handling of addresses with invalid replyToOptions bits.

methods.name: testForNoDeviceIdInReplyToId
methods.description: Ensures reply-to ID excludes device ID when the relevant flag is false.

methods.name: testForDeviceAndTenantIds
methods.description: Checks that tenant and device IDs are correctly extracted into the response.

methods.name: testFromWithReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Verifies that the response correctly indicates usage of legacy endpoint when specified.

methods.name: testFromMessageWithReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks that a message indicating legacy endpoint usage is parsed correctly.
